q: 今天很冷，每___学生都穿着厚外套。
zh: 今天很冷，每个学生都穿着厚外套。
py: jīn tiān hěn lěng měi gè xué sheng dōu chuān zhe hòu wài tào
en: It is cold today and every student is wearing a thick coat.
why: 每 must be followed by a measure before the noun: 每个学生. 每学生 is impossible, and 每些 does not exist.

q: 我昨天买了一___厚大衣，下雪的时候穿。
zh: 我昨天买了一件厚大衣，下雪的时候穿。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn hòu dà yī xià xuě de shí hou chuān
en: I bought a thick overcoat yesterday to wear when it snows.
why: With a number the noun needs its measure, and an overcoat is a top-type garment: 件. ∅ drops the measure; 条 is for trousers and skirts.

q: 医生让我吃这___种药，别的先别吃。
zh: 医生让我吃这两种药，别的先别吃。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ chī zhè liǎng zhǒng yào bié de xiān bié chī
en: The doctor told me to take these two kinds of medicine and leave the others for now.
why: The number goes between 这 and the measure: 这两种药. 这些种药 stacks two measure slots, and 这个种 is not Chinese.

q: 春天到了，院子里有两___桃树开花了。
zh: 春天到了，院子里有两棵桃树开花了。
py: chūn tiān dào le yuàn zi lǐ yǒu liǎng kē táo shù kāi huā le
en: Spring has come and two peach trees in the yard are in blossom.
why: Trees are counted with 棵, and a number cannot touch the noun without a measure (两桃树). 朵 is for the flowers, not the tree.

q: 医生一再提醒，这三___药不能和酒一起吃，不然会很危险。
zh: 医生一再提醒，这三种药不能和酒一起吃，不然会很危险。
py: yī shēng yī zài tí xǐng zhè sān zhǒng yào bù néng hé jiǔ yì qǐ chī bù rán huì hěn wēi xiǎn
en: The doctor warned again that these three kinds of medicine must not be taken with alcohol.
why: After 这三 a measure is required: 种 for kinds of medicine. 些 never combines with 三, and 这三药 drops the measure.

q: 外面下雨了，你带一___伞吧。
zh: 外面下雨了，你带一把伞吧。
py: wài miàn xià yǔ le nǐ dài yī bǎ sǎn ba
en: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.
why: An umbrella has a handle you grip, so 把. 张 is for flat things, 支 for pens, 本 for bound books.

q: 我发烧了，妈妈拿来一___退烧药让我吃。
zh: 我发烧了，妈妈拿来一片退烧药让我吃。
py: wǒ fā shāo le mā ma ná lái yī piàn tuì shāo yào ràng wǒ chī
en: I had a fever, so mum brought me a tablet of fever medicine to take.
why: Tablets are thin flat pills counted with 片. 封 is for letters, 把 for things with handles, 条 for long bendy things.

q: 秋天到了，地上落了一___黄叶。
zh: 秋天到了，地上落了一片黄叶。
py: qiū tiān dào le dì shàng luò le yī piàn huáng yè
en: Autumn has come and a yellow leaf has fallen on the ground.
why: A leaf is a thin flat piece, so 片. 朵 is for flowers and 棵 for whole trees, not for a single leaf.

q: 护士拿来一___体温计，让我量一量体温。
zh: 护士拿来一支体温计，让我量一量体温。
py: hù shì ná lái yī zhī tǐ wēn jì ràng wǒ liáng yi liáng tǐ wēn
en: The nurse brought a thermometer and asked me to take my temperature.
why: A thermometer is a slim stick-like instrument counted with 支. 把 is for things you grip, 本 for books, 条 for long bendy things.

q: 他一直在咳嗽，我给他递了一___纸巾。
zh: 他一直在咳嗽，我给他递了一张纸巾。
py: tā yì zhí zài ké sòu wǒ gěi tā dì le yī zhāng zhǐ jīn
en: He kept coughing, so I handed him a tissue.
why: A tissue is a flat sheet: 张. 本 is for bound volumes, 条 for long things, 把 for handles.

q: 听说明天有大雪，奶奶特意在我的包里放了一___又厚又长的围巾。
zh: 听说明天有大雪，奶奶特意在我的包里放了一条又厚又长的围巾。
py: tīng shuō míng tiān yǒu dà xuě nǎi nai tè yì zài wǒ de bāo lǐ fàng le yī tiáo yòu hòu yòu zhǎng de wéi jīn
en: I heard it will snow heavily tomorrow, so Grandma put a thick, long scarf in my bag.
why: A scarf is long and bendy, so 条. 件 is for tops and 张 for flat sheets. 一件围巾 sounds like a mistake.

q: 暴雨过后，小路上倒了一___大树，车都过不去。
zh: 暴雨过后，小路上倒了一棵大树，车都过不去。
py: bào yǔ guò hòu xiǎo lù shàng dào le yī kē dà shù chē dōu guò bù qù
en: After the storm a big tree had fallen across the small road and no cars could get past.
why: Whole trees take 棵. 朵 is for flowers, 条 for roads or rivers, and 片 for thin slices or leaves.

q: 夏天太热了，我家新买了一___空调。
zh: 夏天太热了，我家新买了一台空调。
py: xià tiān tài rè le wǒ jiā xīn mǎi le yī tái kōng tiáo
en: It is so hot in summer that we bought a new air conditioner.
why: An air conditioner is a machine, so 台. 辆 is for wheeled vehicles, 部 for phones and films, 匹 for horses.

q: 雪地里有一___小鸟在找东西吃。
zh: 雪地里有一只小鸟在找东西吃。
py: xuě dì lǐ yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo zài zhǎo dōng xi chī
en: There is a little bird in the snow looking for something to eat.
why: Small birds take 只. 头 is for cattle and pigs, 条 for fish and snakes, 匹 for horses.

q: 下大雨了，路上的车很少，只有一___公共汽车慢慢开过来。
zh: 下大雨了，路上的车很少，只有一辆公共汽车慢慢开过来。
py: xià dà yǔ le lù shàng de chē hěn shǎo zhǐ yǒu yī liàng gōng gòng qì chē màn màn kāi guò lái
en: It was pouring and there were few cars; only one bus came slowly along.
why: A bus runs on wheels, so 辆. 台 is for machines and 部 for phones, and 只 would count animals.

q: 台风快来了，农场里的那两___牛都被带进了棚里。
zh: 台风快来了，农场里的那两头牛都被带进了棚里。
py: tái fēng kuài lái le nóng chǎng lǐ de nà liǎng tóu niú dōu bèi dài jìn le péng lǐ
en: A typhoon was coming, so those two cows on the farm were brought into the shed.
why: Cattle take 头. 匹 is for horses, 条 for fish, and 只 is for small animals and birds.

q: 医院新买了一___大机器，可以给病人检查身体。
zh: 医院新买了一台大机器，可以给病人检查身体。
py: yī yuàn xīn mǎi le yī tái dà jī qì kě yǐ gěi bìng rén jiǎn chá shēn tǐ
en: The hospital bought a big new machine that can examine patients.
why: A machine takes 台. 辆 is for vehicles, 匹 for horses and 条 for fish, none of which fits a machine.

q: 农场的人说，下暴雨以前，那几___猪一直不肯吃东西。
zh: 农场的人说，下暴雨以前，那几头猪一直不肯吃东西。
py: nóng chǎng de rén shuō xià bào yǔ yǐ qián nà jǐ tóu zhū yì zhí bù kěn chī dōng xi
en: The farmer said that before the downpour those few pigs refused to eat.
why: Pigs are counted with 头, like cattle. 匹 is only for horses, 辆 for wheeled vehicles, and 条 for fish and snakes.

q: 这___药店离我家很近，我感冒的时候常去。
zh: 这家药店离我家很近，我感冒的时候常去。
py: zhè jiā yào diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn wǒ gǎn mào de shí hou cháng qù
en: This pharmacy is close to my home and I often go there when I have a cold.
why: A pharmacy is a business, so 家. 间 is for rooms, 座 for big fixed structures, 层 for floors.

q: 我们住的房间在二十___，窗外可以看到下雪。
zh: 我们住的房间在二十层，窗外可以看到下雪。
py: wǒ men zhù de fáng jiān zài èr shí céng chuāng wài kě yǐ kàn dào xià xuě
en: Our room is on the twentieth floor and you can see snow outside the window.
why: Floors of a building are counted with 层. 间 counts the room itself, 座 a whole building and 家 a business.

q: 我们家有四___人，冬天常常一起吃火锅。
zh: 我们家有四口人，冬天常常一起吃火锅。
py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén dōng tiān cháng cháng yì qǐ chī huǒ guō
en: There are four people in my family and in winter we often have hot pot together.
why: Members of a family are counted with 口. 间 is for rooms, 层 for floors and 座 for big structures.

q: 下大雨以后，那___桥被水冲坏了，我们只好走另一条路。
zh: 下大雨以后，那座桥被水冲坏了，我们只好走另一条路。
py: xià dà yǔ yǐ hòu nà zuò qiáo bèi shuǐ chōng huài le wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zǒu lìng yī tiáo lù
en: After the heavy rain that bridge was washed out so we had to take another road.
why: Bridges are big fixed structures counted with 座. 家 is for businesses, 层 for floors and 口 for family members.

q: 医院的这___病房很安静，朝南，下午有阳光。
zh: 医院的这间病房很安静，朝南，下午有阳光。
py: yī yuàn de zhè jiān bìng fáng hěn ān jìng cháo nán xià wǔ yǒu yáng guāng
en: This hospital ward is quiet, faces south and gets sun in the afternoon.
why: A room takes 间. 家 counts businesses, 座 big structures and 口 family members.

q: 那___山冬天常常下雪，山顶上一年四季都是白的。
zh: 那座山冬天常常下雪，山顶上一年四季都是白的。
py: nà zuò shān dōng tiān cháng cháng xià xuě shān dǐng shàng yī nián sì jì dōu shì bái de
en: That mountain often has snow in winter and its top is white all year round.
why: Mountains take 座. 层 is for floors, 家 for businesses and 口 for family members.

q: 我家住在六___，没有电梯，生病的时候上楼很难。
zh: 我家住在六层，没有电梯，生病的时候上楼很难。
py: wǒ jiā zhù zài liù céng méi yǒu diàn tī shēng bìng de shí hou shàng lóu hěn nán
en: We live on the sixth floor with no lift, so it is hard to climb the stairs when I am ill.
why: Floors are counted with 层. 间 is a room, 座 is a whole building or mountain and 家 is a business.

q: 这座城市夏天又热又潮，所以市中心新开了好几___卖空调和风扇的商店。
zh: 这座城市夏天又热又潮，所以市中心新开了好几家卖空调和风扇的商店。
py: zhè zuò chéng shì xià tiān yòu rè yòu cháo suǒ yǐ shì zhōng xīn xīn kāi le hǎo jǐ jiā mài kōng tiáo hé fēng shàn de shāng diàn
en: The summers in this city are hot and damp, so several shops selling air conditioners and fans have opened downtown.
why: Shops are businesses, counted with 家. 口 is for family members, 座 for big fixed structures and 层 for floors.

q: 夏天的时候，我们一家四___人经常开车去海边度假。
zh: 夏天的时候，我们一家四口人经常开车去海边度假。
py: xià tiān de shí hou wǒ men yī jiā sì kǒu rén jīng cháng kāi chē qù hǎi biān dù jià
en: In summer the four of us often drive to the seaside for a holiday.
why: Family members are counted with 口: 一家四口人. 位 is polite for others and cannot be used about one's own family here.

q: 感冒了，多喝几___热水就会好一点儿。
zh: 感冒了，多喝几杯热水就会好一点儿。
py: gǎn mào le duō hē jǐ bēi rè shuǐ jiù huì hǎo yì diǎn r
en: If you have a cold, drink a few cups of hot water and you'll feel better.
why: A cup is the measure for a drink: 几杯热水. 双 is for pairs, 套 for sets, 份 for portions.

q: 天太热了，我一口气喝了两___冰水。
zh: 天太热了，我一口气喝了两瓶冰水。
py: tiān tài rè le wǒ yì kǒu qì hē le liǎng píng bīng shuǐ
en: It was so hot that I drank two bottles of iced water in one go.
why: Bottled water is counted by the bottle: 瓶. 双 is for pairs, 份 for portions and 套 for sets.

q: 我生病的时候，妈妈给我煮了一___热粥。
zh: 我生病的时候，妈妈给我煮了一碗热粥。
py: wǒ shēng bìng de shí hou mā ma gěi wǒ zhǔ le yī wǎn rè zhōu
en: When I was ill, Mum cooked me a bowl of hot porridge.
why: Porridge is eaten from a bowl and counted by it: 碗. 把 is for things with handles, 套 for sets, 双 for pairs.

q: 冬天路滑，爸爸给我买了一___防滑的鞋。
zh: 冬天路滑，爸爸给我买了一双防滑的鞋。
py: dōng tiān lù huá bà ba gěi wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng fáng huá de xié
en: The roads are slippery in winter, so Dad bought me a pair of non-slip shoes.
why: Shoes come as two separate items, so 双. 件 is for tops, 条 for trousers and 套 for sets.

q: 医生说我可以吃东西了，我点了一___清淡的午饭。
zh: 医生说我可以吃东西了，我点了一份清淡的午饭。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ kě yǐ chī dōng xi le wǒ diǎn le yī fèn qīng dàn de wǔ fàn
en: The doctor said I could eat again, so I ordered a light lunch.
why: A portion of food ordered in a restaurant is a 份. 双 is for pairs, 瓶 for bottles and 套 for sets.

q: 天冷了，奶奶给我织了一___厚手套。
zh: 天冷了，奶奶给我织了一双厚手套。
py: tiān lěng le nǎi nai gěi wǒ zhī le yī shuāng hòu shǒu tào
en: It has got cold, so Grandma knitted me a pair of thick gloves.
why: Gloves come as a pair, so 双. 条 is for long things, 套 for sets and 件 for tops.

q: 夏天容易出汗，我每天都要多喝几___水。
zh: 夏天容易出汗，我每天都要多喝几杯水。
py: xià tiān róng yì chū hàn wǒ měi tiān dōu yào duō hē jǐ bēi shuǐ
en: I sweat easily in summer, so I have to drink a few more cups of water every day.
why: 杯 is already the measure, so no 个 is added (个杯) and no 的 follows it (杯的水).

q: 医生建议我换一___更安静的房子，这样晚上才能睡好。
zh: 医生建议我换一套更安静的房子，这样晚上才能睡好。
py: yī shēng jiàn yì wǒ huàn yī tào gèng ān jìng de fáng zi zhè yàng wǎn shàng cái néng shuì hǎo
en: The doctor advised me to move to a quieter flat so that I can sleep well at night.
why: A flat is counted as a set of rooms with 套. 双 is for pairs, 份 for portions and 瓶 for bottles.

q: 夏天太热，他一连吃了三___西瓜，结果肚子疼了。
zh: 夏天太热，他一连吃了三块西瓜，结果肚子疼了。
py: xià tiān tài rè tā yī lián chī le sān kuài xī guā jié guǒ dǔ zi téng le
en: It was so hot that he ate three pieces of watermelon in a row and ended up with a stomach ache.
why: A piece cut from a melon is a chunk, 块. 杯 is for drinks, 双 for pairs and 套 for sets.

q: 她因为身体不好，辞掉了原来那___工作。
zh: 她因为身体不好，辞掉了原来那份工作。
py: tā yīn wèi shēn tǐ bù hǎo cí diào le yuán lái nà fèn gōng zuò
en: Because of her poor health she gave up her former job.
why: A job is counted with 份. 套 is for sets, 双 for pairs and 杯 for cups.

q: 昨天下了一___大雪，路上到处都是白的。
zh: 昨天下了一场大雪，路上到处都是白的。
py: zuó tiān xià le yī chǎng dà xuě lù shàng dào chù dōu shì bái de
en: It snowed heavily yesterday and the roads are white everywhere.
why: A fall of snow that runs its course is counted with 场. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 门 for courses.

q: 我今天上午有两___课，下午去医院。
zh: 我今天上午有两节课，下午去医院。
py: wǒ jīn tiān shàng wǔ yǒu liǎng jié kè xià wǔ qù yī yuàn
en: I have two classes this morning and go to the hospital in the afternoon.
why: Class periods on a timetable are counted with 节. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 场 for events.

q: 我感冒好了，今天想吃一___好吃的。
zh: 我感冒好了，今天想吃一顿好吃的。
py: wǒ gǎn mào hǎo le jīn tiān xiǎng chī yī dùn hǎo chī de
en: My cold has gone and today I want to have a nice meal.
why: A meal is counted with 顿. 场 is for matches and rain, 首 for songs, 门 for courses.

q: 这个学期我选了一___关于健康的课，老师是位医生。
zh: 这个学期我选了一门关于健康的课，老师是位医生。
py: zhè ge xué qī wǒ xuǎn le yī mén guān yú jiàn kāng de kè lǎo shī shì wèi yī shēng
en: This term I chose a course on health, and the teacher is a doctor.
why: Choosing a subject for a term is a course, 门. 节 would be one period on the timetable, which you cannot choose.

q: 下午第二___是体育课，下雨的话就在室内上。
zh: 下午第二节是体育课，下雨的话就在室内上。
py: xià wǔ dì èr jié shì tǐ yù kè xià yǔ de huà jiù zài shì nèi shàng
en: The second period this afternoon is PE, and if it rains it will be held indoors.
why: Ordinal slots of the school day are 节: 第二节. 门 counts different subjects, not periods.

q: 夏天的晚上，公园里有一___露天音乐会，很多人去听。
zh: 夏天的晚上，公园里有一场露天音乐会，很多人去听。
py: xià tiān de wǎn shàng gōng yuán lǐ yǒu yī chǎng lù tiān yīn yuè huì hěn duō rén qù tīng
en: On summer evenings there is an open-air concert in the park and many people go.
why: A concert is an event that runs its course: 场. 首 would count single songs.

q: 她唱了一___关于春天的歌，大家都鼓掌了。
zh: 她唱了一首关于春天的歌，大家都鼓掌了。
py: tā chàng le yī shǒu guān yú chūn tiān de gē dà jiā dōu gǔ zhǎng le
en: She sang a song about spring and everyone applauded.
why: Songs are counted with 首. 场 is for events, 部 for films and 门 for courses.

q: 这___感冒在冬天特别常见，不一定要吃药。
zh: 这种感冒在冬天特别常见，不一定要吃药。
py: zhè zhǒng gǎn mào zài dōng tiān tè bié cháng jiàn bù yí dìng yào chī yào
en: This kind of cold is very common in winter and doesn't always need medicine.
why: 'This kind of' is 这种. 门, 场 and 首 count courses, events and songs, not types.

q: 因为下大雨，那___足球比赛被取消了。
zh: 因为下大雨，那场足球比赛被取消了。
py: yīn wèi xià dà yǔ nà chǎng zú qiú bǐ sài bèi qǔ xiāo le
en: Because of the heavy rain, that football match was cancelled.
why: A match is an event counted with 场. 首 is for songs, 部 for films and 门 for courses.

q: 一___春雨过后，山上的树都变绿了。
zh: 一场春雨过后，山上的树都变绿了。
py: yī chǎng chūn yǔ guò hòu shān shàng de shù dōu biàn lǜ le
en: After one spring rain the trees on the hills all turned green.
why: A fall of rain is counted with 场. 首 is for songs, 顿 for meals and 部 for films or novels.

q: 为了不感冒，你应该好好吃每一___饭，不要饿着肚子去上班。
zh: 为了不感冒，你应该好好吃每一顿饭，不要饿着肚子去上班。
py: wèi le bù gǎn mào nǐ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo chī měi yī dùn fàn bú yào è zhe dǔ zi qù shàng bān
en: To avoid catching a cold, you should eat every meal properly and not go to work hungry.
why: Meals are counted with 顿: 每一顿饭. 场 is for events, 首 for songs and 门 for courses.

q: 医生让我每天吃三___药，饭后吃。
zh: 医生让我每天吃三次药，饭后吃。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī sān cì yào fàn hòu chī
en: The doctor told me to take the medicine three times a day after meals.
why: Occasions of an action are counted with 次. 趟 is for trips, 场 for events, and 个 is not a measure for times.

q: 我昨天去了一___医院，医生说我没事。
zh: 我昨天去了一趟医院，医生说我没事。
py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng yī yuàn yī shēng shuō wǒ méi shì
en: I went to the hospital yesterday and the doctor said I was fine.
why: A trip somewhere is counted with 趟. 遍 means going through something from start to finish.

q: 医生说这个药很难吃，你把说明书从头到尾读一___再吃。
zh: 医生说这个药很难吃，你把说明书从头到尾读一遍再吃。
py: yī shēng shuō zhè ge yào hěn nán chī nǐ bǎ shuō míng shū cóng tóu dào wěi dú yī biàn zài chī
en: The doctor said the medicine is hard to take, so read the instructions from beginning to end once before you take it.
why: 从头到尾 spells out a full pass through a text, which is 遍. 趟 is for a trip there and back.

q: 她感冒好了以后，又去了两___医院复查。
zh: 她感冒好了以后，又去了两次医院复查。
py: tā gǎn mào hǎo le yǐ hòu yòu qù le liǎng cì yī yuàn fù chá
en: After her cold got better she went to the hospital twice more for a check-up.
why: Visits are simply occurrences, counted with 次. 遍 needs something read or watched all the way through, and 个 is not a measure for times.

q: 护士让我再量一___体温，因为刚才的数字不太准。
zh: 护士让我再量一次体温，因为刚才的数字不太准。
py: hù shì ràng wǒ zài liáng yī cì tǐ wēn yīn wèi gāng cái de shù zì bù tài zhǔn
en: The nurse asked me to take my temperature once more because the earlier reading was not accurate.
why: A repeated action is counted with 次. 趟 needs a journey and 场 an event, and 个 does not count actions.

q: 今年夏天我感冒了两___，每次都发烧。
zh: 今年夏天我感冒了两次，每次都发烧。
py: jīn nián xià tiān wǒ gǎn mào le liǎng cì měi cì dōu fā shāo
en: I caught a cold twice this summer and had a fever each time.
why: Occasions of catching a cold are counted with 次. 遍 and 趟 imply going through something or travelling, and 场 is for events.

q: 这首关于春天的歌，我从头到尾听了三___，还是没听懂。
zh: 这首关于春天的歌，我从头到尾听了三遍，还是没听懂。
py: zhè shǒu guān yú chūn tiān de gē wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi tīng le sān biàn hái shì méi tīng dǒng
en: I listened to this song about spring three times all the way through and still did not understand it.
why: 从头到尾 makes it a full pass through the song, so 遍. 趟 is a journey and 个 does not count times.

q: 奶奶住院的时候，爸爸每个星期都要跑好几___医院，一天也没休息过。
zh: 奶奶住院的时候，爸爸每个星期都要跑好几趟医院，一天也没休息过。
py: nǎi nai zhù yuàn de shí hou bà ba měi gè xīng qī dōu yào pǎo hǎo jǐ tàng yī yuàn yī tiān yě méi xiū xī guò
en: When Grandma was in hospital Dad had to make several trips to the hospital every week without a day off.
why: Going back and forth to a place is 趟. 遍 is a start-to-finish pass through content, 场 an event and 顿 a meal.

q: 这___药都是医生给我的，一天吃三次。
zh: 这些药都是医生给我的，一天吃三次。
py: zhè xiē yào dōu shì yī shēng gěi wǒ de yī tiān chī sān cì
en: These medicines were all given to me by the doctor and I take them three times a day.
why: 这些 is the plural 'these' and goes straight on the noun; with 都 it must be plural. 这个药 is singular and 本 is for books.

q: 我买了一些___水果，想送给生病的同学。
zh: 我买了一些水果，想送给生病的同学。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ xiǎng sòng gěi shēng bìng de tóng xué
en: I bought some fruit to give to my classmate who is ill.
why: 一些 takes the noun directly, with no second measure. 一些块水果 and 一些片水果 are not Chinese.

q: 我只喝了一点儿___水，还是很渴。
zh: 我只喝了一点儿水，还是很渴。
py: wǒ zhǐ hē le yì diǎn r shuǐ hái shì hěn kě
en: I only drank a little water and I was still thirsty.
why: 一点儿 fills the measure slot itself, so nothing may follow it. 一点儿杯水 and 一点儿个水 are wrong.

q: 那___不爱穿厚衣服的同学，最近都感冒了。
zh: 那些不爱穿厚衣服的同学，最近都感冒了。
py: nà xiē bù ài chuān hòu yī fu de tóng xué zuì jìn dōu gǎn mào le
en: Those classmates who don't like wearing thick clothes have all caught colds recently.
why: Several people need the plural 那些 (no second measure). With 都 the subject is plural, so 那个 and 那条 fail.

q: 夏天来了，商店里新到了一些___西瓜，又大又便宜。
zh: 夏天来了，商店里新到了一些西瓜，又大又便宜。
py: xià tiān lái le shāng diàn lǐ xīn dào le yī xiē xī guā yòu dà yòu pián yi
en: Summer is here and some new watermelons have arrived in the shop, big and cheap.
why: 一些 goes straight on the noun. Adding a measure (一些块西瓜) is a mistake.

q: 下了几天雨，衣服都潮了，这___衣服都得拿出去晒。
zh: 下了几天雨，衣服都潮了，这些衣服都得拿出去晒。
py: xià le jǐ tiān yǔ yī fu dōu cháo le zhè xiē yī fu dōu děi ná chū qù shài
en: After several days of rain the clothes are damp, and all these clothes have to be put out in the sun.
why: The clothes are many and 都 marks them as plural, so 这些. 这件 and 这条 count a single item.

q: 医生说我的病不严重，只要多休息，再吃一点儿___药就能好。
zh: 医生说我的病不严重，只要多休息，再吃一点儿药就能好。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ de bìng bù yán zhòng zhǐ yào duō xiū xī zài chī yì diǎn r yào jiù néng hǎo
en: The doctor said my illness is not serious: with more rest and a little more medicine I'll recover.
why: 一点儿 takes the noun directly. 一点儿片药 and 一点儿种药 add a second measure, which is not allowed.

q: 我每___都跑步，身体越来越好。
zh: 我每天都跑步，身体越来越好。
py: wǒ měi tiān dōu pǎo bù shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo
en: I run every day and I am getting healthier.
why: 天 is itself a measure, so 每天 takes no 个. 每个天 is wrong, and 每年 would mean every year, not every day.

q: 我感冒了，在家休息了两___。
zh: 我感冒了，在家休息了两天。
py: wǒ gǎn mào le zài jiā xiū xī le liǎng tiān
en: I had a cold and rested at home for two days.
why: 两天 needs no 个, because 天 is a measure word on its own.

q: 他生病了，在医院住了三___月。
zh: 他生病了，在医院住了三个月。
py: tā shēng bìng le zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè yuè
en: He was ill and stayed in hospital for three months.
why: Counting months needs 个: 三个月. Without it 三月 means March.

q: 医生让我休息两___星期，不能去上班。
zh: 医生让我休息两个星期，不能去上班。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ xiū xī liǎng gè xīng qī bù néng qù shàng bān
en: The doctor told me to rest for two weeks and not go to work.
why: 星期 is a noun and takes 个 when counted: 两个星期. 两天星期 and 两年星期 are not Chinese.

q: 他每天睡八___小时，所以身体很好。
zh: 他每天睡八个小时，所以身体很好。
py: tā měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
en: He sleeps eight hours a day, so he is in good health.
why: 小时 is a noun that takes 个: 八个小时. 八天小时 and 八次小时 do not exist.

q: 这个夏天特别热，已经三___月没下雨了。
zh: 这个夏天特别热，已经三个月没下雨了。
py: zhè ge xià tiān tè bié rè yǐ jīng sān gè yuè méi xià yǔ le
en: This summer has been very hot and it has not rained for three months.
why: Counting months needs 个: 三个月. 三月 would be March. 三年 would be a different length of time and does not match the cue.

q: 我们这里的冬天很长，一年有四___月都在下雪。
zh: 我们这里的冬天很长，一年有四个月都在下雪。
py: wǒ men zhè lǐ de dōng tiān hěn cháng yī nián yǒu sì gè yuè dōu zài xià xuě
en: Winters are long here and it snows for four months of the year.
why: A count of months needs 个: 四个月. 四月 is April, and 四天 would be only four days.

q: 我在南方住了五___，已经习惯了这里又湿又热的夏天。
zh: 我在南方住了五年，已经习惯了这里又湿又热的夏天。
py: wǒ zài nán fāng zhù le wǔ nián yǐ jīng xí guàn le zhè lǐ yòu shī yòu rè de xià tiān
en: I lived in the south for five years and have got used to the hot, damp summers there.
why: 年 is already a measure, so 五年 takes no 个. 五个年 is wrong.

q: 医生说，每___星期至少要运动三次，每次三十分钟。
zh: 医生说，每个星期至少要运动三次，每次三十分钟。
py: yī shēng shuō měi gè xīng qī zhì shǎo yào yùn dòng sān cì měi cì sān shí fēn zhōng
en: The doctor said you should exercise at least three times every week, thirty minutes each time.
why: 星期 needs 个 when 每 is used: 每个星期. 每天星期 and 每次星期 are not Chinese.

q: 这几___夏天越来越热，大家都买了空调。
zh: 这几年夏天越来越热，大家都买了空调。
py: zhè jǐ nián xià tiān yuè lái yuè rè dà jiā dōu mǎi le kōng tiáo
en: Summers have been getting hotter in recent years and everyone has bought an air conditioner.
why: 年 is a measure itself, so 这几年 takes no 个. 这几个年 is wrong.

q: 他一直发烧，在家躺了半___月才好。
zh: 他一直发烧，在家躺了半个月才好。
py: tā yì zhí fā shāo zài jiā tǎng le bàn gè yuè cái hǎo
en: He kept running a fever and lay at home for half a month before he got better.
why: Months are counted with 个: 半个月. 半天 is half a day and 半年 half a year, neither of which matches the cue.

zh: 医生给我开了三种药。
py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le sān zhǒng yào
en: The doctor prescribed me three kinds of medicine.
why: The measure 种 attaches to the number (三种) and both go before the noun 药; the number cannot follow it.

zh: 今天下了一场大雪。
py: jīn tiān xià le yī chǎng dà xuě
en: It snowed heavily today.
why: The number and measure 一场 sit between the verb 下了 and the noun 大雪, and the time word stays in front.

zh: 我每天喝八杯水。
py: wǒ měi tiān hē bā bēi shuǐ
en: I drink eight cups of water every day.
why: 八杯 is number plus container measure, directly before the noun 水, with no 个 or 的 in between.

zh: 他在医院住了两个月。
py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le liǎng gè yuè
en: He stayed in hospital for two months.
why: A length of time goes after the verb: 住了两个月. 两个月 keeps 个 because 月 is a noun, and it cannot come before the verb.

zh: 这三种药都要饭后吃。
py: zhè sān zhǒng yào dōu yào fàn hòu chī
en: All three of these medicines have to be taken after meals.
why: With 这 and a number the order is 这 + 三 + 种 + 药. 三 comes between 这 and the measure, never before 这.

zh: 昨天晚上下了一场大雨。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ
en: It rained heavily last night.
why: 一场 goes right before 大雨 and after 下了, the same way a number and measure precede any noun.

zh: 我去过两次医院。
py: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì yī yuàn
en: I have been to the hospital twice.
why: The action count 两次 comes after 去过, and the place 医院 follows it; 两次 cannot sit before the verb.

zh: 医院门口有两棵很大的树。
py: yī yuàn mén kǒu yǒu liǎng kē hěn dà de shù
en: There are two very big trees at the hospital entrance.
why: The number and measure 两棵 go before the whole description 很大的树, because the measure comes straight after the number.

zh: 妈妈给我买了一双防滑的鞋。
py: mā ma gěi wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng fáng huá de xié
en: Mum bought me a pair of non-slip shoes.
why: 一双 is number plus measure for shoes, placed before the modifier 防滑的 and the noun 鞋.

zh: 去年我在北京住了三个月。
py: qù nián wǒ zài běi jīng zhù le sān gè yuè
en: Last year I lived in Beijing for three months.
why: The duration 三个月 follows the verb 住了. 个 stays because 月 is a noun; a time word like 去年 may stand before or after 我.

s: 医生给我开了两药。
s_py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le liǎng yào
zh: 医生给我开了两种药。
py: yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le liǎng zhǒng yào
en: The doctor prescribed me two kinds of medicine.
why: A number cannot sit directly on a noun; 种 must come between 两 and 药.

s: 我发烧了，在家休息了两个天。
s_py: wǒ fā shāo le zài jiā xiū xī le liǎng gè tiān
zh: 我发烧了，在家休息了两天。
py: wǒ fā shāo le zài jiā xiū xī le liǎng tiān
en: I had a fever and rested at home for two days.
why: 天 is itself a measure word, so 个 cannot come between 两 and 天.

s: 医生让我每天吃三趟药。
s_py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī sān tàng yào
zh: 医生让我每天吃三次药。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ měi tiān chī sān cì yào
en: The doctor told me to take the medicine three times a day.
why: 趟 counts trips there and back; taking medicine is an occurrence, so 次.

s: 我每个天都去公园跑步。
s_py: wǒ měi gè tiān dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
zh: 我每天都去公园跑步。
py: wǒ měi tiān dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
en: I go jogging in the park every day.
why: 天 is already a measure, so 每天 takes no 个.

s: 我买了一些片药。
s_py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē piàn yào
zh: 我买了一些药。
py: wǒ mǎi le yī xiē yào
en: I bought some medicine.
why: 一些 goes directly on the noun and a second measure like 片 cannot be added.

s: 医生的办公室在三间，请坐电梯上去。
s_py: yī shēng de bàn gōng shì zài sān jiān qǐng zuò diàn tī shàng qù
zh: 医生的办公室在三层，请坐电梯上去。
py: yī shēng de bàn gōng shì zài sān céng qǐng zuò diàn tī shàng qù
en: The doctor's office is on the third floor, so please take the lift up.
why: Floors are counted with 层; 间 counts rooms, so 三间 cannot name a floor.

s: 外面有一位人在等医生。
s_py: wài miàn yǒu yī wèi rén zài děng yī shēng
zh: 外面有一个人在等医生。
py: wài miàn yǒu yí gè rén zài děng yī shēng
en: There is someone outside waiting for the doctor.
why: 位 is not used before bare 人; use 个, or put 位 before a role such as 客人 or 病人.

s: 夏天太热，我买了一辆空调。
s_py: xià tiān tài rè wǒ mǎi le yī liàng kōng tiáo
zh: 夏天太热，我买了一台空调。
py: xià tiān tài rè wǒ mǎi le yī tái kōng tiáo
en: It was so hot in summer that I bought an air conditioner.
why: 辆 counts vehicles; an air conditioner is a machine, so 台.

s: 我想买一条外套，下雪的时候穿。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī tiáo wài tào xià xuě de shí hou chuān
zh: 我想买一件外套，下雪的时候穿。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn wài tào xià xuě de shí hou chuān
en: I want to buy a coat to wear when it snows.
why: 条 is for trousers, skirts and other long bendy things; a coat is a top, so 件.

s: 冬天的时候，我们这里每个年都下很大的雪。
s_py: dōng tiān de shí hou wǒ men zhè lǐ měi gè nián dōu xià hěn dà de xuě
zh: 冬天的时候，我们这里每年都下很大的雪。
py: dōng tiān de shí hou wǒ men zhè lǐ měi nián dōu xià hěn dà de xuě
en: In winter it snows heavily here every year.
why: 年 is a measure itself, so 每年 takes no 个.

s: 医生让我把这份说明书从头到尾读两趟。
s_py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn shuō míng shū cóng tóu dào wěi dú liǎng tàng
zh: 医生让我把这份说明书从头到尾读两遍。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhè fèn shuō míng shū cóng tóu dào wěi dú liǎng biàn
en: The doctor told me to read this instruction sheet twice from beginning to end.
why: Reading all the way through is 遍. 趟 needs a journey, and reading a sheet is not one.

s: 我们家有三口人，都爱喝热茶。
s_py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén dōu ài hē rè chá
zh: 我们家有三口人，都爱喝热茶。
py: wǒ men jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén dōu ài hē rè chá
en: There are three of us in the family and we all like hot tea.
why: Family members are counted with 口, so 三口人 is correct.

s: 那位医生很年轻，可是看病很认真。
s_py: nà wèi yī shēng hěn nián qīng kě shì kàn bìng hěn rèn zhēn
zh: 那位医生很年轻，可是看病很认真。
py: nà wèi yī shēng hěn nián qīng kě shì kàn bìng hěn rèn zhēn
en: That doctor is young but very conscientious with patients.
why: 位 is the polite measure before a role word like 医生, so 那位医生 is correct.

s: 她感冒了，在家躺了两个星期。
s_py: tā gǎn mào le zài jiā tǎng le liǎng gè xīng qī
zh: 她感冒了，在家躺了两个星期。
py: tā gǎn mào le zài jiā tǎng le liǎng gè xīng qī
en: She had a cold and lay at home for two weeks.
why: 星期 is a noun that takes 个, so 两个星期 is correct.

s: 他每天睡七个小时，可是还是觉得累。
s_py: tā měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí kě shì hái shì jué de lèi
zh: 他每天睡七个小时，可是还是觉得累。
py: tā měi tiān shuì qī gè xiǎo shí kě shì hái shì jué de lèi
en: He sleeps seven hours every day and still feels tired.
why: 每天 takes no 个 but 小时 does, so 七个小时 is correct.

s: 一连下了三天雨，河水涨得很高。
s_py: yī lián xià le sān tiān yǔ hé shuǐ zhǎng de hěn gāo
zh: 一连下了三天雨，河水涨得很高。
py: yī lián xià le sān tiān yǔ hé shuǐ zhǎng de hěn gāo
en: It rained for three days in a row and the river rose very high.
why: 天 takes no 个, so 三天 is correct and 三个天 would be wrong.

s: 这些药一天吃两次，每次一片。
s_py: zhè xiē yào yī tiān chī liǎng cì měi cì yī piàn
zh: 这些药一天吃两次，每次一片。
py: zhè xiē yào yī tiān chī liǎng cì měi cì yī piàn
en: Take these medicines twice a day, one tablet each time.
why: 这些 goes straight on 药 with no further measure; 次 and 片 count the times and tablets.

s: 这几年冬天越来越暖和，下雪的次数比以前少多了。
s_py: zhè jǐ nián dōng tiān yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo xià xuě de cì shù bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le
zh: 这几年冬天越来越暖和，下雪的次数比以前少多了。
py: zhè jǐ nián dōng tiān yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo xià xuě de cì shù bǐ yǐ qián shǎo duō le
en: Winters have got warmer in recent years and it snows much less often than before.
why: 年 takes no 个, so 这几年 is correct.

s: 昨天晚上下了一场大雨，今天早上路上还有很多水。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ jīn tiān zǎo shàng lù shàng hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
zh: 昨天晚上下了一场大雨，今天早上路上还有很多水。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shàng xià le yī chǎng dà yǔ jīn tiān zǎo shàng lù shàng hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
en: There was heavy rain last night and the road still has a lot of water this morning.
why: A fall of rain is counted with 场, so 一场大雨 is correct.

s: 我想喝一点儿热水，再吃一片药。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng hē yì diǎn r rè shuǐ zài chī yī piàn yào
zh: 我想喝一点儿热水，再吃一片药。
py: wǒ xiǎng hē yì diǎn r rè shuǐ zài chī yī piàn yào
en: I'd like a little hot water and then to take a tablet.
why: 一点儿 goes straight on 热水, while the tablet gets its own measure 片, so both are correct.
